Type three

Data sharing between multiple components

This can be done using behaviour subject with the help of angular services

First Create a service using below command

ng generate service serviceName (ng g s serviceName)

Now create object for BehaviorSubject class 

 {{code1}}

create a variable you want to share between multiple components using subject

applicationData = this.behaviorSubjectObj.asObservable();

asObservable() will observe every change and store updated value in applicationData variable

To change the value , create a function with parameter and store the parameter in the subject like below

 {{code2}}

The next() will update the default value in the subject

Now to use the variable applicationData in any component follow the below steps

step-1

Go to the component you want use and import the service file

{{code3}}

step-2

Now create object for the serviceClassName in component constructor
